papers.title: Global Knowledge Portrait
papers.current_ceiling: The scoped structured-mapping claim is supported; the existing corpus uniquely reduces to polarity and cannot establish necessity of other coordinates.
post_matrix_updates: The anti-confounding theory package was recovered to main; it remains a design object until an external ontology corpus is prospectively bound.
load_bearing_adverse: The current corpus is solvable by the unique reduct {polarity}.
Raw-text extraction superiority, universal coordinate necessity and downstream answer-quality gain are explicitly unclaimed.
The journal package is a stale 20-page render of a 45-page manuscript.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The coordinate system needs an anti-confounded external semantic corpus containing matched-polarity opposite-verdict pairs and ontology-native gold.
papers.decisive_question: Across GO, Uberon and EFO, do the non-polarity coordinates provide leave-one-ontology-out decision information once polarity, lexical form and label frequency are matched?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A structured semantic portrait contains transferable decision information beyond polarity on anti-confounded ontology reasoning tasks.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: After exact polarity matching, removing each claimed load-bearing coordinate should cause a prospectively predicted loss on native-verifier judgments, and the full mapping should transfer to a held-out ontology.
papers.population_or_universe: Version-pinned ontology assertions and query/decision pairs from E10 meeting predeclared licensing, provenance, polarity-matching and native-reasoner rules.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Matched pair or set of ontology decisions with equal polarity and opposite native verdict.
design: Generate matched-polarity opposite-verdict pairs using ontology-native semantics.
Freeze train/design ontologies and one leave-one-ontology-out confirmation split.
Bind raw source assertions, reasoner version and gold derivation.
Compare full coordinates, polarity-only and donor semantic embeddings/mappings.
Perform coordinate knockouts only as prospectively declared ablations.
primary_endpoints: Exact verdict accuracy on matched pairs.
Per-coordinate conditional information or ablation loss.
analysis_plan: Coordinate necessity is a conditional ablation claim, not a universal metaphysical claim.
Ontology-level transfer is reported separately before pooling.
Multiplicity across coordinate ablations is frozen and controlled.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust all generated pairs satisfying the frozen matching rule, with a minimum per-ontology count fixed before verdict access.
papers.success_gate: The full mapping beats polarity-only and donor baselines on matched pairs, declared coordinate ablations behave as predicted and transfer holds on the held-out ontology.
papers.refutation_gate: Polarity-only parity, unstable coordinate necessity or failure on the held-out ontology limits the claim to the bounded structured-mapping result.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if matching, reasoner gold, ontology versions or coordinate extraction cannot be reproduced independently.
papers.authority_required: Native ontology reasoners plus independent semantic-domain review of query validity and coordinate interpretation.

active_lane.collision_rule: Keep E10 outcomes paper-disjoint and do not use the current polarity corpus as confirmation.

immediate_safe_actions: Rebuild the stale journal package and rerun claim-to-PDF audit.
Specify the matched-polarity pair generator and native-reasoner gold.
Run a primary-source ontology-representation novelty subtraction.
forbidden_actions: Do not claim universal coordinate necessity.
Do not generate synthetic labels without native reasoner authority.
Do not let polarity imbalance re-enter through sampling.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier knowledge-representation paper needs anti-confounded native-semantic tasks, ontology-level holdout, donor baselines and coordinate-level mechanism evidence.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns structured semantic portrait coordinates; regime transport belongs to ORION-17.
